name: max_pool3d
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::max_pool3d(Tensor self, int[3] kernel_size, int[3] stride=[], int[3] padding=0, int[3] dilation=1, bool ceil_mode=False) -> Tensor. Applies three-dimensional max pooling to batched or unbatched inputs. Coverage includes cubic and non-cubic kernels, scalar and per-dimension arguments, default stride, padding, dilation, ceil mode, common 3D-CNN shapes and small inputs. This artifact intentionally excludes max_pool3d_with_indices, which is a separate canonical-name exception. The operation does not mutate or alias self. The current FlagGems implementation explicitly does not support autograd.
